handoff: Reviewer classification, then bounded Implementer correction or stop at unchanged original cutoff.
limitations: Correct provisioning identifier membership is diagnostic evidence from current Mac and selected profile; it is not complete two-App live preflight or runtime DPK authorization
No actual device identifiers, account identities or profile contents are public
Historical first-App chain/signature evidence remains valid for unchanged binary/profile; no new signing or App execution occurred

officialSources.summary: Apple silicon Mac development registration requires the provisioning UDID.
Mac device ID is shown as Hardware UUID on macOS 10.15 and earlier, Provisioning UDID on macOS 11 and later.
System Information Hardware supplies the Mac provisioning UDID used for registration.

requiredFixes: Use the current Mac provisioning device identifier instead of assuming IOPlatformUUID is the provisioning UDID; retain selected-device membership, group, profile dates and original time window. Independent review and bounded code correction required; no re-registration or policy relaxation.
scope: Readonly partial first-App host/device applicability diagnosis; no DPK data measurement
